title: Spain: The future of strawberry depends on more promotion and more varieties - eComercio Agrario
summary: The unusual heat this winter, which is doing so much damage to other crops, has been a joy for strawberry growers. High temperatures in December and January have ripened fruit at a time in which there is little competition from other producing countries, and that's a start of campaign for optimism.
